title: Brand New G6 Sensor gives "Sensor Failed Start" Error
symptom: A brand new Dexcom G6 sensor fails to start in xDrip+, giving multiple 'Sensor Failed Start' errors during warmup, despite the app finding the transmitter and starting warmup.
cause: The G6 transmitter has a crude restart detection mechanism that can trigger even with a brand new sensor, likely due to not waiting long enough after removing the old sensor before starting a new one.
fix: To avoid the issue, keep the transmitter out of the sensor for at least 10 minutes before starting. After stopping the old sensor, wait for it to stop, remove it, set a timer for 10 minutes, and only then snap the transmitter into the new sensor. If subsequent start attempts still fail, perform a restart as per the provided guide.
evidence_quote: A G6 transmitter has a crude restart detection mechanism.  It can trigger even with a brand new sensor! To avoid it, make sure to keep the transmitter out of the sensor for at least 10 minutes before starting.
